parsed.production_notes: The primary visual is a static, AI-generated image of a man and a female-presenting robot, a common trope in AI art. The image remains perfectly still throughout, with only text and graphic overlays changing.
parsed.interaction_pattern: AI tutor corrects a learner's spontaneous wrong-English mistake.
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue in Kannada and English between a male learner and a female-voiced AI tutor. There is no background music.

characters.appearance: A South Asian man in his late 20s or early 30s with a very muscular, athletic build and a tanned complexion. He has short, styled dark hair and a well-groomed short beard and mustache. He has strong facial features.
characters.wardrobe: Black swim trunks and dark sunglasses. He wears a thin silver chain necklace and a simple black bracelet on his left wrist.
characters.demeanor: Relaxed, confident, and then curious and impressed.

characters.appearance: A female-presenting humanoid robot. She has the face of a young woman with fair skin, defined features, and dark hair, but her neck, arms, and legs are visibly robotic, made of white and metallic components with exposed joints. Her voice is a clear, standard female voice.
characters.wardrobe: A white, terry cloth bathrobe, worn open, and dark sunglasses.

scenes.setting: A bright, sunny day at a swimming pool. The water is a vibrant turquoise.

panels.panel_visual_description: A high-angle, top-down shot of a swimming pool with bright turquoise water. On the left, a muscular, tanned man (Character A) with short dark hair and a beard lies on a white inflatable lounger. He is shirtless, wearing black swim trunks and sunglasses. On the right, a female-presenting humanoid robot (Character B) lies on a similar white lounger. She has a human-like face and dark hair, wearing sunglasses, but her body is robotic. She wears an open white bathrobe. Both are looking up towards the camera.
